title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_beauty_and_the_billionaire_the_wedding_a_billion_by_jessica_clare_lhmmr (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_beauty_and_the_billionaire_the_wedding_a_billion_by_jessica_clare_lhmmr' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Full control of the affected system may be given to an outside entity, potentially exposing all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different computer is strongly advised.
